execution_mode: Each unittest case executes in an isolated Python interpreter; executable evaluations use isolated fixture repositories and isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME directories.
limitations: The suite validates deterministic local behavior, synthetic hook payloads, migration safety, release gates, and executable offline evaluations.
Live Codex model quality, native platform behavior, real subagent ordering, cancellation delivery, and cross-client reconnect require RC evidence.
verification_note: The 116-case verified seed baseline is preserved. Product OS 4.1 adds four receipt v2 compatibility cases, five rebuildable-registry cases, and ten read-only detection/dry-run planning cases covering v1 path safety, runtime activity, managed/plugin drift, stable hashes, adapter-bound authority, exact source roots and lineage markers, full package inventory integrity, plugin-version binding, no-write CLI behavior, conservative registry handling, and fail-closed external state validation.
